req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-031 requires GET /players/ to return all players sorted by insertion (id) order. The pre-loaded fixture has 26 rows with deterministic UUIDs. Tests must verify: (1) HTTP 200 status, (2) all 26 players returned, (3) ordering matches insertion/id order (first player id=5a9cd988..., last=da31293b...), (4) exact field values for boundary players (first and last), and (5) negative path for malformed requests. Mutation-resilient assertions use exact counts, exact UUIDs, exact squad numbers, and exact ordering comparisons.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_rows
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 player rows
actions: Send GET /players/ with no query parameters
expected: HTTP 200 response
Response body is a JSON array of exactly 26 elements
First element has id '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' and squadNumber 1
Last element has id 'da31293b-4c7e-5e0f-a168-469ee29ecbc4' and squadNumber 26
trace: R-PLAYER-031: list players in insertion (id) order
EP: valid GET request on populated database
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_rows():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 26
    first = data[0]
    assert first['id'] == '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'
    assert first['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert first['firstName'] == 'Franco'
    assert first['lastName'] == 'Armani'
    last = data[25]
    assert last['id'] == 'da31293b-4c7e-5e0f-a168-469ee29ecbc4'
    assert last['squadNumber'] == 26
    assert last['firstName'] == 'Nahuel'
    assert last['lastName'] == 'Molina'

tests.name: test_get_all_players_response_is_array_not_object
actions: Inspect the top-level JSON type and count
expected: HTTP 200
Response Content-Type is application/json
Top-level JSON value is a list (not a dict)
List length is exactly 26
trace: R-PLAYER-031: response must be a list of all players
EP + type-mutation: catches mutations that wrap list in object or truncate it
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_response_is_array_not_object():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers['content-type']
    data = r.json()
    assert type(data) is list
    assert len(data) == 26
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in data]
    assert squad_numbers[0] == 1
    assert squad_numbers[-1] == 26
    assert squad_numbers == list(range(1, 27))

Both calls return exactly 26 items

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_ordering_is_stable_across_two_calls():
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    data1 = r1.json()
    assert len(data1) == 26
    ids1 = [p['id'] for p in data1]
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data2 = r2.json()
    assert len(data2) == 26
    ids2 = [p['id'] for p in data2]
    assert ids1 == ids2
    assert ids1[0] == '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'
    assert ids1[25] == 'da31293b-4c7e-5e0f-a168-469ee29ecbc4'

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_squad_numbers_monotonically_increasing():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 26
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in data]
    expected = list(range(1, 27))
